buildCommand: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && cp index.html dist/index.html && cp upgrade.js dist/upgrade.js && cp upgrade.css dist/upgrade.css && python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; p=Path('dist/index.html'); s=p.read_text(); s=s.replace('</head>','<link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"/upgrade.css\"></head>'); s=s.replace('</body>','<script src=\"/upgrade.js\"></script></body>'); p.write_text(s)"
